report_en: A slope gave way at {place}. The survey marked the exposed rock above the debris.
Part of the shelf at {place} fell into the water. The revised survey shows where the shoreline runs now.
Falling rock opened a shelf inside {place}. The crew left a marker where the new rock begins.
Wind stripped the loose soil at {place}. The ridge on the new survey was buried when you left.
The roof at {place} came down. The rubble is still inside the footprint.
Runoff cut a new channel at {place}. The survey team walked both banks before posting the update.
A drive bearing failed at {place}. The crew isolated the unit. It is waiting for repair.
The feed assembly at {place} buckled. The crew cleared the jam and left the unit shut down for repair.
